baselineIdentity.integrity: Archive CRC, safe paths and all manifest sizes/SHA-256 PASS; all 1011 original entries also rechecked against immutable extracted baseline before final assembly.

versionDecision: Minor release for conditional equipment decision explanations, independent item ownership, live reward controls and explicit save capacity/empty-state guidance. Schema, keys, IDs, rarity gates, formulas, prices and gameplay RNG unchanged.
mainChanges: Open and buy deep-copy the awarded item using the existing copy helper. Historical shop/loot records remain snapshots; inventory owns an independent object, including unknown nested data.
Reward center and rail resolve current owned item by ID for lock controls. Sold offers are explicitly marked as purchase-time attributes.

Equipment cards distinguish base damage/survival estimates from changing conditional effects. On-demand details expose triggers, effective caps and included/approximate/omitted coverage, with three relic replacement slots.
Settings provide an explicit complete-envelope UTF-8 capacity check with exact remaining/excess bytes and export guidance. No measurement was added to per-render or per-transaction paths.
Full merchant/black-market inventory explains the restriction and links to inventory. Empty filters can be cleared without changing inventory, currency or sort.
regressionGuards: All original 56 test modules plus 2 fixtures and all 8 font/license files remain byte-identical. No original input file removed.
Save schema5, full expected snapshots and unknown fields, Web Locks, primary/mirror/legacy/archive ordering and the existing 5,000,000-byte new-write boundary are preserved.
Original manual six-room loop, one-to-six dice, one currency, five equipment slots, eight rarity gates and original combat/economy/loot formulas remain.
No new runtime dependencies, runtime bitmaps or generated decorative imagery. Existing renderer, effects and motion implementation unchanged.
Historical snapshot locked/enhance differences caused by ownership correction are declared and fully enumerated; they are not silently removed from cross-version comparisons.

testSummary.simulationComparison: Complete raw JSON bytes and all 377 scalar leaves equal; no normalization or excluded fields.

ownership.differenceScope: Only historical shop/loot locked/enhance leaves. Player assets, RNG, revision and logs equal.

saveClosure.limitation: Legacy closure reloads before each step. The new continuous-vs-reload ownership audit covers the alias gap separately.

capacity.boundary: 4,999,900 -> 5,000,724 rejects with zero writes; 5,000,000 -> 4,999,853 salvage commits; historical 5,012,445 -> 5,012,307 still rejects and remains fully exportable.

conditionalComparison.stateComparison: All-state fingerprints equal after replacing only generated runId with date-normalized; all other state fields retained. completeCommittedStatesSha256 chains these normalized fingerprints.
conditionalComparison.reportComparison: gameplayOnly recursively excludes detail, hint and adapter. Only constructed/natural gameplay objects enter comparison; outer sourceVersion, sourceHashes and durationSeconds are not compared. Full raw reports retain these fields.
conditionalComparison.roundTripComparison: Each of the 14 complete encode/decode deep-equality assertions per version is unnormalized, including original runId.
conditionalComparison.sampleBoundary: One natural constrained journey and short surviving branches; not population-level balance, spending-value or difficulty proof.

browser.counts: Final suites once; overlapping independent probes and development reruns not added.

fonts.historicalRepairRecords: NOT_AVAILABLE in input; not reported as new PASS

lifecycle.scope: Software browser and explicit fault injection; not physical GPU reset, OS suspension or FPS measurement.

performance.claim: No stable speed gain, no performance equivalence/no-regression claim, and no physical 4K60 claim. Inventory direction reverses across batches; this does not close the separately observed frame risks. One sample per frame cell and no reversed frame matrix limit causality.

artifactBudget.archiveIdentity: Exact final ZIP bytes, decimal MB, file count and SHA-256 are supplied outside the archive. The manifest excludes itself; no cyclic archive identity.

openRisks: P2 severe software-renderer long frames; current maximum longer in 13/16 main pairs and all 8 Eternal pairs. 4K Eternal full max 8993.4ms and current loot-7 unobserved. Five full-effect windows unobserved overall; not visual PASS.
P2 near-5MB accepted saves may reject a later growing write; capacity UI explains and exports but does not reduce data, raise limits or eliminate synchronous write costs.
P3 natural constrained 400-floor sample has real retaliation/injured starting states, but all 12-battle branches still survive; broader natural survival evidence needed.
P3 unchanged storage listener ignores localStorage.clear key=null and lacks immediate feedback when both main and mirror are deleted. Memory remains exportable; next expected-guarded save rejects.
Physical phones/pen, external screen readers, human audio listening, OS background/power loss, private player saves, native Windows launcher and physical GPU are not validated.
nextRoundPriorities: Separate real save/DOM/layout/compositor/effect tails with controlled paired samples and retain worst windows.
Design lossless capacity-reduction guidance while preserving unknown fields and full expected/primary/mirror contracts.
Extend natural constrained multi-seed combat and conditional decision follow-up without artificial difficulty changes.
Define recoverable cross-tab behavior for clear/missing-both storage events and test it natively.
Validate real devices and assistive input while preserving current desktop/narrow-window behavior.
finalPackageProtocol: After all files and manifest are assembled, verify the exact delivered ZIP into a new empty directory, including CRC/paths/all hashes/extracted bytes. Rerun syntax, all 539 fine-grained cases and HTTP there. Deliver only after these gates pass. Archive identity and final extraction receipts stay external to the ZIP to avoid self-reference; embedded evidence is source-tree validation.
